The local government use a questionnaire to find out if local people have benefited from the debt for nature swap.

(i) The method used to select the people was:

- select one street in São Paulo at random
- select every female aged between 20 and 30 in each house on the street.

Describe the limitations of this selection method.

[3]

(ii) One of the questions on the questionnaire is shown.

| **question** | **response** |   |
|---|---|---|
| yes | no |   |
| Did you benefit from the debt for nature swap? |   |   |

Describe **one** reason why yes /no response questions are used in a questionnaire.

[1]
